method: LLM agents read the whole tree in six areas (the C++ app object, list models and scroll path, chat pages, Rust core, magic numbers, remaining pages and the notification service); measured on the Jolla Phone 2026 and the Pro1-X; clear findings fixed in small commits that each build; open values decided after the audit (see the .md). Ledger written after the fact (2026-11-17) from the narrative; the narrative is the source.

findings.what: Logging out left the old account's room list in memory (a filter change showed it again), its open thread, pending pushes, emote cache and notified invitations
Verification watchers not tied to the login outlived a logout, keeping the old client's crypto objects alive
Opening a room held the core's state lock across a network await
In a thread, Reply after an edit sent the edit's text; clearing a reply wiped the typed text
Text put back by the app (draft, cancelled edit) sent typing notices; starting an edit lost the draft
Settings switches stopped following their setting after the first tap (broken binding)
The 'Latest edit' heading showed its raw id
An empty line under the sender's name in some reply quotes
A binding loop per muted room at every list build
Message text: HTML rewrite and Twemoji pass ran three to five times per row; any change rebound the whole row; the room list re-emitted every row between first and last change
Each room update rebuilt notification settings per room and asked twice whether the room is direct
The room sort re-read every room's fields per comparison; about thirteen QSettings objects made on the fly
Every message row built its reply quote, media, poll, caption, upload bar, reactions and thread lines, shown or not
The chat's place keeping searched the whole timeline every frame while holding the place
Two composers (room, thread) drifted apart; place keeping and its trace woven through a 924 line page
commands.rs mixed dispatch with a dozen commands' logic; seven helpers copied across six core files
About a hundred literals, settings keys and D-Bus names repeated; round avatar shader x4, banner rows x4, five texts defined twice
Rustrx.cpp 1229 lines: room lists, media and process handover in one file
The cover's unread action skipped direct chats
Errors shown in place were also shown as a global notice
A logout during a call left the call membership live
The shared debug log bundle missed the push log
refresh_rooms, unignore_user, recovery_reset never sent
findings.status: DECIDED kept; recovery_reset got its button (2c4c3ba); unignore_user's page queued for 0.4.7

findings.what: Whether a network error while sending leaves a room's send queue off until restart was unverified
findings.status: OPEN, traced by the 2026-11-17 audit as C1

findings.what: translations/harbour-rustrx.ts stale

found_in_testing.what: The app's own settings (list order, filters, debug switches) lost at every restart: the sandbox discarded ~/.config/net.mowerk/harbour-rustrx.conf (0.4.5 too)
A reaction the server refused blocked its room's send queue, even across restarts
A thread's first message acted on through the thread timeline sent reactions twice
In a thread, + opened no picker and React with text did nothing
A tap on a picture or sound still sending showed an error
A quick reaction from the menu sometimes did nothing (counting rebuilt the buttons mid-tap)
A room could send a read receipt every frame
The message field slid under the keyboard as a long message grew (0.4.5, reported by dodoradio)
A shared photo without a known file ending went out as a plain file
A lost recovery key could not be replaced
Twemoji images installed with the executable bit
The thread emoji picker jumped when swapping with the keyboard
